headline: Moniepoint MFB expands physical banking with new regional HQ in Abuja
summary: Moniepoint Microfinance Bank opened its North Central regional headquarters in Abuja to satisfy central bank regulatory rules requiring expanded physical branches.
why: Moniepoint is one of Nigeria's largest fintech and microfinance banking institutions.

impacts.name: Moniepoint
impacts.why: Opening physical headquarters ensures full compliance with CBN licensing mandates.
